title: Cold rebuild: count error codes
summary: Rebuild the log error counter from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Count error codes across a folder of logs** in *Files, text and other programs*. Now write it again from an **empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed the first time.
pathlib, a compiled regex and `Counter` are the shape of most report scripts you will write at work: this is worth being able to type without looking.

code: lines = ["ERROR E042 disk", "WARN E042 retry", "ERROR E007 up", "ERROR E007 again"]
c = Counter(m.group(1) for l in lines if (m := re.search(r"ERROR (E\d{3})", l)))
steps.explain: Only the three ERROR lines count; `E007` appears twice.

steps.title: Rebuild count_errors cold
prompt: Write `count_errors(folder: Path) -> dict[str, int]` again: every `*.log` file in `folder` and its subfolders, each line with `ERROR` followed later by a code like `E042`, counted per code, highest count first, then by code.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty.
